visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman is shown in a tight close-up, looking directly at the lens. A pair of hands from off-screen applies eye makeup using a small brush. She rolls her eyes upwards, showing a large area of the whites of her eyes, appearing slightly strained. The lighting is bright and clinical, typical of a studio setting. (2) The camera angle moves lower, looking up at her chin. The makeup artist continues to work on her lower eyelid. The woman's facial expressions are exaggerated to emphasize the difficulty of the process. (3) A sequence focusing on her eyes shows her blinking rapidly. Visual text overlays appear around her eyes to emphasize the action. (4) The scene details the application of individual eyelash extensions. Numbers 1 through 4 appear sequentially as each cluster is glued on. The woman is holding a white cotton pad under her eye to protect her skin. (5) A quick transition occurs with animated pink and white cloud graphics covering the center of the frame. (6) The woman reappears in a wide-angle medium shot, fully transformed. She wears a silver, sequined dress and has her hair in two long braids. The background is a festive interior with a large pink Christmas tree and white decor. She poses confidently, blowing a kiss and smiling at the camera.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: One main female creator/model; hands of a makeup artist are visible but the person is off-screen.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman initially shown with bare skin and natural hair, later transformed with heavy makeup, false eyelashes, braided hair, and a sparkly white evening dress.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The initial background is a neutral, white studio wall with some professional lighting equipment visible. The final scene features an elaborate festive set with a pink Christmas tree, white cotton ground (mimicking snow), and gift boxes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic female voice speaks Chinese over a bouncy electronic pop track. The speech is casual and friendly. (2) As the speaker mentions 'who understands this', her pitch inflections become more dramatic and whining for comedic effect. A 'ding' sound effect highlights the visual variety text. (3) The vocal pace increases slightly while describing blinking. The BGM remains steady with a synth-driven rhythm. (4) Four distinct, sharp 'pop' sounds are triggered in sync with numerical graphics appearing on screen. The voice counts along with the sounds. (5) A shimmering, magical chime SFX plays during the visual transformation transition, with the music momentarily swelling in volume and spectral brightness. (6) The vocal becomes even more high-arousal and joyful, praising the result. The background music maintains its upbeat tempo. The final section features a clear, professional narration promoting a photography service with a friendly call-to-action.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote professional photography and makeup services by showcasing a relatable struggle with eye makeup followed by a stunning, high-quality transformation.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The final slogan explicitly invites viewers to book photography or wedding shoots through the video's information section.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a popular short-form content format where a creator shares a 'struggle' (the physical discomfort of professional eye makeup) to humanize the process, making the final 'pretty' reveal more impactful for marketing purposes.
